scripts.text:
truncate table stg.delft_cur_rates;

with cur as
 (select 
	ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by site_ref, from_curr_code, to_curr_code, eff_date order by VariationNumber desc)rn
	,site_ref
	,from_curr_code
	,to_curr_code
	,buy_rate
	,sell_rate
	,dateadd(HOUR,2, CAST(eff_date as datetime)) as eff_date
  from [raw].[csi_currate_mst]
  where DLDeleteIndicator = 0)
  insert into stg.delft_cur_rates
  select 
	site_ref
	,from_curr_code
	,to_curr_code
	,buy_rate
	,sell_rate
	,eff_date
  from cur where rn = 1;
